complexity.notes: Correctly handles duplicate minimums by pushing on <= and popping only on equality. Initializing min_stack with float('inf') avoids an empty-check in push; all operations are cleanly O(1) with no hashing involved.
complexity.summary: Maintains a main stack plus an auxiliary min stack that records each new running minimum (including duplicates), so getMin is just a peek at the min stack's top; pop discards the min entry only when the popped value equals the current minimum.
